purpose: Fresh live verification of PyPI provenance auditing with independent curl artifact hashing and runtime report assertions.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
def load(name,path):
 p=root/path; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
matches=[(cid,e) for cid,e in reg.items() if e.get('status')=='VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY' and (e.get('source') or {}).get('type')=='pypi']
assert len(matches)==1,matches
cid,entry=matches[0]
sel_rel='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYPI_PROVENANCE_VERIFY_SELECTION.json'
meta_rel='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYPI_PROVENANCE_VERIFY_METADATA.json'
report_rel='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYPI_PROVENANCE_VERIFY_REPORT.json'
(root/sel_rel).write_text(json.dumps({'id':cid,'record':entry},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
fetch=load('hf_verify','canonical/runtime/bound_capabilities/http_json_fetch.py')
audit=load('pa_verify','canonical/runtime/bound_capabilities/pypi_provenance_audit.py')
runtime=load('rt_verify','canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py')
fetch_res=fetch.run({'source_json_path':sel_rel,'url_key':'metadata_url','output_path':meta_rel},root)
audit_res=audit.run({'selection_path':sel_rel,'metadata_path':meta_rel,'report_path':report_rel},root)
report=json.loads((root/report_rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
curl=subprocess.run(['curl','-fsSL',report['artifact_url']],capture_output=True,timeout=120)
assert curl.returncode==0,curl.stderr[-1000:]
curl_hash=hashlib.sha256(curl.stdout).hexdigest()
assert curl_hash==report['recorded_hash']==report['live_metadata_hash']==report['downloaded_artifact_hash']
assert_action=runtime._goal_action({'type':'assert_json_fields_equal','args':{'path':report_rel,'fields':['recorded_hash','live_metadata_hash','downloaded_artifact_hash'],'true_fields':['verified']}})
assert assert_action['verified'] is True,assert_action
print(json.dumps({'fetch':fetch_res,'audit':audit_res,'curl_artifact_sha256':curl_hash,'independent_assertion':assert_action},sort_keys=True))
print('PYPI_PROVENANCE_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
